crossRefs.note: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on…
He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and…
He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people…
In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

translations.web: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
translations.kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
translations.asv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
